_about: Corrected annotations for MAMS-ACSA's 'place' category. MAMS assigns all 863 of these to a single category; reviewed against the sentence text, they resolve to several different aspects, and 46% carry no aspect signal of their own - either duplicating an aspect already annotated on the same sentence, or firing on the tokens 'bar'/'place' where they are not places at all ('bar none', 'a bar of chocolate', 'raise the bar', restaurant names, other venues).
_schema: key '<mams split>:<sentence index>' -> {category, polarity}. category 'drop' means the annotation is discarded, and polarity is then null. Keys are stable because the MAMS files are pinned by commit and SHA-256 in scripts/download_data.py.
